set.body:
Scope
Freeze the public mathematical language before adding estimators.

Acceptance criteria
- Exact formulas, variables, geometry, normalization, symmetry, and statistical estimands are recorded for anchor refinement, exact spectral frames, joint sparse-functional factorization, generalized low-rank models, and multiblock programs.
- AnchorRegularizedFrame and jointly estimated SparseFunctionalFactorization are distinct public concepts.
- Each model family names its admissible solver class and maximum possible guarantee.
- Unsupported combinations and counterexamples are explicit.
- A typed claim ledger maps formula identity to API identity, IR identity, theorem assumptions, achieved evidence, and oracle family.
- Construction rejects blank identifiers, mismatched model/estimand families, and guarantees stronger than the family permits.
- Contract and law tests run in shared sources on JVM and JS.
- Design follows extant SemanticAlgebra, OperatorProgram, FunctionalFrame, and ModelSpec terminology without parallel legacy concepts.
set.title: Multivar math 0: freeze estimands, nomenclature, theorem and claim ledger
